paper.title: MSGNav: Unleashing the Power of Multi-modal 3D Scene Graph for Zero-Shot Embodied Navigation

claim: MSGNav的结果不能说明零样本导航已解决：作者明确指出VFM/VLM延迟阻碍实时部署，且最后一公里仅被缓解而未被彻底解决。

evidence.summary: 结论段直接给出两项残余问题，构成对榜单增益的部署边界。
evidence.short_quote: Despite these advantages of MSGNav , scene graph-based methods still face low inference efficiency due to the latency of VFMs and VLMs, suggesting future work on faster graph construction and inference for real‑time deployment. Additionally, while the “last-mile” problem has been mitigated by the VVD module, it is not fully resolved.

paper_reading.relation: 限制“感知增强后的零样本目标导航已经解决”这一命题。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 该原文位于结论的限制段，逐字同时限定实时性和最后一公里；卡片没有把模拟结果外推到真实部署。

claim: 主动感知能改善固定视角VLA，但并未解决通用感知；论文在最难的组合泛化任务上仍报告明显退化。

evidence.summary: 结果段在报告总体领先的同时明确指出最难L4任务性能下降。
evidence.short_quote: Although performance decreases on the most difficult L4 tasks (1.2%), ActiveVLA still demonstrates promising long-horizon reasoning and strong 3D perception for precise manipulation.

paper_reading.relation: 支持“主动感知是必要补丁”，限制“感知问题已经解决”。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 原句直接位于GemBench结果分析，卡片只据此指出最难任务退化，没有声称主动感知对所有任务无效。

evidence.summary: 结论直接同时报告感知饱和和两类仍关键的误差。

paper_reading.verification_rationale: 原句直接总结了必要词表与关键误差类型；卡片保持为该架构和任务内的条件性结论。

claim: 现有VLN的高层推理并未克服物理执行：即使CoT改善理想化传送设置，严格物理条件下性能仍低，碰撞是主要瓶颈。

evidence.summary: 零样本实验把同一代理放入传送和严格物理设置，直接暴露碰撞导致的退化。
evidence.short_quote: Strikingly, when we introduce CoT prompting, performance in the Tel-Hop setting improves further, yet performance in the Strict setting remains low. This result strongly confirms that physical collision is the primary bottleneck.

paper_reading.relation: 限制“VLN榜单已经等价于真实导航能力”。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 原文在同一实验段比较Tel-Hop与Strict并明确归因碰撞；卡片未把仿真碰撞率外推为真实事故率。

paper.title: HaltNav: Reactive Visual Halting over Lightweight Topological Priors for Robust Vision-Language Navigation

claim: 真实VLN鲁棒性依赖显式结构先验、异常检测和重规划；没有这些机制的基线在目标式指令或阻塞下会出现灾难性退化。

evidence.summary: 实机结果段直接比较基线在目标式和障碍注入条件下的崩溃。
evidence.short_quote: The real world dramatically amplifies both failure modes observed in simulation. Under goal-only instructions (L2-B), InternVLA-N1 collapses to 0% SR and StreamVLN to 13.33%, far below their simulation counterparts. Under obstacle injection, both baselines drop to 0% SR across all conditions—even StreamVLN, which retained 37.50% in simulation.

paper_reading.relation: 表明导航不是单次规划已解决，而是恢复闭环仍属核心能力。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 原文是实机评测的直接结果；卡片只据此强调恢复和先验的条件性，不把单一建筑概括为所有导航。
